Paris becomes the AI capital of the world this July.
We'll be there.

As founders, investors, executives, and ecosystem leaders gather for RAISE Summit, Yorkseed is opening the doors to Yorkseed House — a curated venture headquarters designed to bring the global innovation ecosystem together beyond the conference floor.

More than an event venue — a place to work, meet, recharge, collaborate, and build meaningful relationships throughout the week. Drop in. Drop out. Come back anytime.

Complimentary · Advance Registration Required
Hosted at OBWB

Central Paris
near the Louvre

Yorkseed House is proudly hosted at the Paris office of OBWB (Osha Bergman Watanabe & Burton) — a leading international intellectual property law firm advising startups, scaleups, and investors on IP, AI, patents, trademarks, and innovation strategy.

Located in Central Paris, steps from the Louvre and RAISE Summit. We are grateful to Jonathan and the entire OBWB team for opening their doors.

Venue — OBWB Paris Office
Steps from — Carrousel du Louvre (RAISE Summit venue)
Hours — 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM · Monday–Friday
Access — Complimentary · Advance registration required

Introducing

Valois

val · WAH

The room within the room.

Valois is the private upper layer of Yorkseed — a relationship infrastructure for family offices, GPs, LPs, and allocators operating at the intersection of capital, access, and trust.

Not a platform. Not a club. Not a perk bundle. A Circle of people who move capital, broker relationships, and make decisions in rooms most people do not reach. Membership is by referral or direct application, subject to a discreet vetting process.
